WITH base_pop AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.client_id AS patient_id
  FROM (
    SELECT
      client_id,
      TIMESTAMPDIFF(
        DAY,
        MAX(return_visit_date),
        :endDate
      ) AS ltfp_days
    FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card
    WHERE encounter_date <= :endDate
      AND return_visit_date >= :startDate
    GROUP BY client_id
  ) a

  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT person_id
    FROM person
    WHERE dead = 1
      AND death_date <= :endDate
  ) p
    ON p.person_id = a.client_id

  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT mf_to.client_id
    FROM mamba_fact_transfer_out mf_to
    LEFT JOIN mamba_fact_transfer_in mf_ti
      ON mf_ti.client_id = mf_to.client_id
    WHERE mf_to.transfer_out_date <= :endDate
      AND (
        mf_ti.client_id IS NULL
        OR mf_to.transfer_out_date > mf_ti.transfer_in_date
      )
  ) mfto
    ON mfto.client_id = a.client_id

  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT previous.client_id
    FROM (
      SELECT
        client_id,
        TIMESTAMPDIFF(
          DAY,
          MAX(return_visit_date),
          DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
        ) AS ltfp_days
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card
      WHERE encounter_date <= DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
        AND return_visit_date <= DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
      GROUP BY client_id
    ) previous
    WHERE previous.ltfp_days > 28
  ) lost_in_previous_quarter
    ON lost_in_previous_quarter.client_id = a.client_id

  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT client_id
    FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card
    WHERE cd4 < 200
      AND encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
  ) cd4
    ON cd4.client_id = a.client_id

  WHERE a.ltfp_days <= 28
    AND p.person_id IS NULL
    AND mfto.client_id IS NULL
),
ag AS (
  SELECT
    ag.age_group_id,
    ag.label,
    ag.min_age_days,
    ag.max_age_days,
    ag.sort_order
  FROM report_builder_dim_age_group ag
  JOIN report_builder_dim_age_category ac
    ON ac.age_category_id = ag.age_category_id
  WHERE ac.code = 'MOH_105_OPD_DIAG'
    AND ag.is_active = 1
),
genders AS (
  SELECT 'F' AS gender
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'M' AS gender
),
cnt AS (
  SELECT
    ag.age_group_id,
    mdp.gender,
    COUNT(DISTINCT base_pop.patient_id) AS value
  FROM base_pop
  JOIN mamba_fact_patients_latest_patient_demographics mdp
    ON mdp.patient_id = base_pop.patient_id
  JOIN ag
    ON TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, mdp.birthdate, :endDate)
       BETWEEN ag.min_age_days AND ag.max_age_days
  WHERE mdp.birthdate IS NOT NULL
    AND mdp.gender IS NOT NULL
    AND mdp.gender IN ('F','M')
  GROUP BY ag.age_group_id, mdp.gender
)
SELECT
  ag.label AS age_group,
  g.gender AS gender,
  COALESCE(cnt.value, 0) AS value
FROM ag
CROSS JOIN genders g
LEFT JOIN cnt
  ON cnt.age_group_id = ag.age_group_id
 AND cnt.gender = g.gender
ORDER BY ag.sort_order, g.gender;
